acceptance.given: The Skill authoring standard artifact is available for structural inspection.

oracle.expected: The parsed standard explicitly defines evidence, including what evidence is produced or retained and its lifecycle boundary.
forbidden: The standard omits an evidence definition.
Evidence is mentioned only incidentally without defining its role or lifecycle.
oracle.observable: A structural artifact check locates an explicit evidence definition in the standard.

acceptance.then: The artifact check identifies the evidence definition and its lifecycle boundary.
acceptance.when: During static inspection of the standard artifact, check the evidence section and its declared lifecycle boundary.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the standard artifact assertion against the frozen standard content and fail if the evidence definition or lifecycle boundary is absent.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Define evidence and its lifecycle boundary in the Skill authoring standard.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Documentation-only rollback restores the prior standard text; no runtime state or schema changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: The standard moves from lacking an explicit evidence definition to explicitly defining evidence and its lifecycle boundary.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A static artifact assertion finds the explicit evidence definition and lifecycle boundary in the standard.
